info.description: Creates the specified Data Lake Analytics account. This supplies the user with computation services for Data Lake Analytics workloads
info.title: DataLakeAnalyticsAccountManagementClient

requests.description: Gets the first page of Data Lake Analytics accounts, if any, within the current subscription. This includes a link to the next page, if any.
requests.name: GET /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/providers/Microsoft.DataLakeAnalytics/accounts
requests.note: Replace {{DATALAKEANALYTICSACCOUNTMANAGEMENTCLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets the first page of Data Lake Analytics accounts, if any, within a specific resource group. This includes a link to the next page, if any.
requests.name: GET /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.DataLakeAnalytics/accounts
requests.note: Replace {{DATALAKEANALYTICSACCOUNTMANAGEMENTCLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Begins the delete process for the Data Lake Analytics account object specified by the account name.
requests.name: DELETE /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.DataLakeAnalytics/accounts/{accountName}
requests.note: Replace {{DATALAKEANALYTICSACCOUNTMANAGEMENTCLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
